title: Comments and notifications
confirmNote: Review the draft and action before continuing.
deleteConfirm: Delete this comment? Replies will remain.
anchorMissing: The original block was moved or removed
choosePerson: Choose a person who can read this page
mentionNote: Selected people receive an in-app notification. Mentions do not grant access. Email notifications are not sent yet.
inboxNote: Assignments, replies and mentions for pages you can currently read.
emptyThreads: No comments on this page yet
readOnly: You have read-only access to comments
choosePage: Open comments from a page to view and reply to its conversations.
conflict: Content changed. Your draft is retained. Reload to review.
denied: Your account or access could not be verified. Your draft is retained and saving is stopped.
invalid: Check the comment and storage limits. Your draft is retained.
uncertain: The save result is uncertain. It will not be retried automatically. Reload and review.
refreshFailed: The save was acknowledged, but refreshing failed. Reload to review.
reloadConfirm: Discard the draft and reload the current state?
anchorUnavailable: The original block was moved or removed. You cannot comment on this target.
usePageAnchor: Comment on the whole page instead
chooseCurrentTarget: Choose a current target before writing a new comment.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
inlineMentionHint: You were mentioned in the page body. Open the page to review it.
assignmentHint: You were selected in a person property on this record. Open the page to review it.
notificationCapacity: The notification limit was reached. Nothing was saved. Contact an administrator.
